verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own person-tracking feature records which users are affected by each error, so per-issue user impact is documented. There is no evidence of per-issue counts of affected sessions, or of sorting and prioritizing items by affected users rather than occurrence counts. Session Replay (beta) captures sessions around errors but does not quantify session blast radius. Missing for 10: per-issue affected-session counts, documented ranking/prioritization by users affected, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, every issue quantifies real impact — how many users and sessions are affected — so I prioritize by blast radius, not raw event counts

citations.quote: Rollbar can track which of your People (users) are affected by each error.
This works automatically in our Rails and Django
